name: zenoh-node
description: Native Node.js bindings for Zenoh — brokerless, peer-to-peer pub/sub, query and storage with no WebSocket overhead
author: Levi Miller <l3vi@protonmail.ch>

scripts.build:prebuilds: npm run build:prebuilds:x64 && npm run build:prebuilds:arm64
scripts.build:prebuilds:x64: /usr/local/bin/docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -e CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo -e RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup -v $(pwd):/src:ro -v $(pwd)/prebuilds:/output -v zenoh-node-cargo-x64:/root/.cargo/registry -v zenoh-node-build-x64:/work/build node:24-slim sh -c "apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git python3 make g++ cmake curl > /dev/null 2>&1 && curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable > /dev/null 2>&1 && export PATH=/root/.cargo/bin:\$PATH && mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo/bin && ln -sf /root/.cargo/bin/cargo /usr/local/cargo/bin/cargo && ln -sf /root/.cargo/bin/rustc /usr/local/cargo/bin/rustc && mkdir -p /work && cp -r /src/. /work/ && rm -rf /work/build/CMakeCache.txt /work/build/CMakeFiles /work/build/_deps/zenoh_c-build/CMakeCache.txt /work/build/_deps/zenoh_c-build/CMakeFiles && cd /work && npm install --ignore-scripts > /dev/null 2>&1 && ./node_modules/.bin/cmake-js build && mkdir -p /output/linux-x64 && cp build/Release/zenoh_node.node /output/linux-x64/node.napi.node && echo PREBUILD_DONE_x64"
scripts.build:prebuilds:arm64: /usr/local/bin/docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 -e CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo -e RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup -v $(pwd):/src:ro -v $(pwd)/prebuilds:/output -v zenoh-node-cargo-arm64:/root/.cargo/registry -v zenoh-node-build-arm64:/work/build node:24-slim sh -c "apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git python3 make g++ cmake curl > /dev/null 2>&1 && curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable > /dev/null 2>&1 && export PATH=/root/.cargo/bin:\$PATH && mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo/bin && ln -sf /root/.cargo/bin/cargo /usr/local/cargo/bin/cargo && ln -sf /root/.cargo/bin/rustc /usr/local/cargo/bin/rustc && mkdir -p /work && cp -r /src/. /work/ && rm -rf /work/build/CMakeCache.txt /work/build/CMakeFiles /work/build/_deps/zenoh_c-build/CMakeCache.txt /work/build/_deps/zenoh_c-build/CMakeFiles && cd /work && npm install --ignore-scripts > /dev/null 2>&1 && ./node_modules/.bin/cmake-js build && mkdir -p /output/linux-arm64 && cp build/Release/zenoh_node.node /output/linux-arm64/node.napi.node && echo PREBUILD_DONE_arm64"
